purpose: One minimum-code IR-assisted Camera2 YUV capture on the iris camera, aimed at a diffuse non-person target.
target: Matte diffuse surface confirmed by the user; no person, animal, eye, mirror, or reflective enclosure in the beam path.

app.build: Successful; signed with a temporary local test key.

illumination.basis: Previously measured lowest nonzero code; this is not an eye-safety validation.
illumination.helper: Phone-local root helper bound to 127.0.0.1:18761; no ADB forward.
illumination.result: Helper confirmed ON and then OFF after the Camera2 capture-result callback. The exact optical pulse-to-exposure overlap was not measured.

frame.callback: Received one 1920x1080 YUV image and passed it to the in-memory analysis path.
frame.analysisMetrics: Not retained in the host log; the image buffer was discarded by the app after in-memory analysis.

initialAttempt.result: No pulse occurred: Java selected IPv6 ::1 while the helper listened on IPv4 127.0.0.1; connection was refused before any LED write.
initialAttempt.ledsAfterAttempt: All LED brightness nodes read zero.
initialAttempt.fix: App now connects explicitly to 127.0.0.1; the port was checked without issuing a PULSE before retrying.

limitations: This test did not establish a safe operating limit for human exposure.
Camera2 reports UNKNOWN sensor timestamp source, and no photodiode or hardware trigger was used; software callback timing cannot prove optical synchronization.
Only one diffuse-target frame was acquired; no eye was imaged and no biometric recognition or Android authentication was tested.

additional_ir_off_diagnostic.result: One RAW10 inspect request was inadvertently triggered by a screen-coordinate mis-tap after the IR-assisted capture.
additional_ir_off_diagnostic.illumination: All LED channels were already off; no IR was enabled for this request.
